name: SIGINT
standfirst: Security research and practitioner news, scored for novelty and actionability.
colophon: sigint.wtf — the correct response to most of these CVEs. Scored by machine against a hand-written rubric; ranking is opinion, not fact.

items.title: Ultrafast quantum gate operations in a Kramers-Henneberger atom Qubit
items.dek: Kramers-Henneberger atom qubits demonstrate femtosecond single-qubit gates, six orders of magnitude faster than superconducting platforms.
items.unproven: scaling to multi-qubit gates, practical fabrication and control engineering, noise and leakage suppression in hardware implementations

items.title: Exploring the Relaxation Landscape of a 2D Quantum Magnet on a 256-Qubit Processor
items.dek: 256-qubit Rydberg array maps relaxation regimes in 2D Ising model, identifying prethermal and slowdown phases beyond thermalization.
items.unproven: whether results hold at larger scales or different Hamiltonians, classical simulation complexity claims need independent verification

items.title: "Operator, can you hear me?" A Faithful Line into the UNISOC Baseband
items.dek: First faithful re-hosting of UNISOC UDX710 baseband via component-level simulation enables firmware instrumentation and recovery.
items.unproven: does not demonstrate applicability beyond the UDX710 or production impact on supply-chain risk assessment

items.title: SoK: Cryptographic Key Recovery for Cryptoasset Custody and Financial Technologies
items.authors: Francisco Javier Becerra Sanchez et al.
items.dek: Systematization of 77 papers on cryptoasset key recovery defines five recovery archetypes and tradeoff taxonomy.
items.unproven: does not test recovery mechanisms empirically or establish which schema attributes most affect real-world custody decisions

items.title: Non-monotonic dependence of OAM Schmidt spectrum on crystal thickness
items.dek: Orbital angular momentum Schmidt spectrum exhibits nonmonotonic dependence on nonlinear crystal thickness, contrary to prior expectation.
items.unproven: mechanism reproducibility across crystal types and pump configurations, practical utility for high-dimensional entanglement generation

items.title: Many-Body Mobility Edge and Non-Hermitian Skin Effect in an Interacting Quasi-Periodic Spin Chain
items.dek: D-shaped many-body mobility edge in non-Hermitian interacting spin chain delineates localization and skin effect regimes.
items.unproven: experimental realization in accessible platforms, connection to observables in actual devices

items.title: Soft Redaction of Image Provenance via Zero-Knowledge Proofs
items.dek: Zero-knowledge proofs enable soft redaction of image provenance by replacing sensitive assertions with proximity and biometric-embedding distance proofs.
items.unproven: does not validate C2PA adoption timelines, ecosystem readiness, or overhead impact on production image-signing workflows

items.title: Effects of parental controls in the context of Digital Forensics
items.dek: Microsoft, Google, and Apple parental controls impede evidence acquisition on 15 Windows, Android, and iOS devices; study identifies forensically sound workarounds.
items.unproven: does not test whether identified workarounds persist after OS updates or remain admissible in legal proceedings

items.title: Ransomware gangs skip the CEO, head straight for the 40-something IT manager
items.dek: Ransomware operators target mid-level IT staff over executives; social engineering tactic, not technical discovery.
items.unproven: Whether this represents a shift in attacker behavior or reporting bias; no empirical prevalence data across threat intel sources.

items.title: Shopify replaced Redis with MySQL for inventory reservations–and it scaled
items.dek: Shopify migrated inventory reservation logic from Redis to MySQL; architectural choice specific to their scale and schema.
items.unproven: whether the tradeoffs generalize beyond Shopify's specific workload, schema, and operational maturity.

items.title: Managing AI Coding Costs at Scale
items.dek: Databricks cost-management patterns for AI coding tools; establishes vocabulary around token budgets and batching.
items.unproven: applicability beyond Databricks' own infrastructure and use cases; no independent validation of claims

items.title: Demonstration of an LLO CV-QKD system over 12 km of optical fiber
items.authors: Christiano M. S. Nascimento et al.
items.dek: CV-QKD system with independent transmitter and receiver lasers demonstrates 5.11 Mbit/s key rates over 12 km fiber.
items.unproven: Post-quantum migration planning is on the reader's roadmap, but this is a physics demonstration of one QKD variant, not a deployment risk assessment or migration pathway; no assessment of when or whether this replaces current key exchange in financial infrastructure.

items.title: Observation of far-from-equilibrium scaling in the transient dynamics of 2D quantum magnets
items.dek: Rydberg-atom arrays show mean-field scaling in quench dynamics across multiple 2D lattice geometries.
items.unproven: Quantum simulation on analog hardware does not inform application security, secure SDLC, or agent governance in financial services.

items.title: The web server deployment model breaks at hobby scale
items.dek: Discussion of web server deployment model constraints at small scale.
items.unproven: specific architectural or security implications for the reader's tooling and SDLC process

items.title: Rate-Fidelity Control for Wide-Area Quantum Links
items.dek: Adaptive control protocol for quantum network links improves entanglement distribution rate 14% by dynamically tuning power and polarization compensation.
items.unproven: generalization beyond 64 km fiber traces, applicability to deployed networks with different environmental conditions or hardware

items.title: Many-Body Localization Induced by Correlated Disorder in Interacting Superconducting Qubits
items.authors: Thiago R. Girão Souza et al.
items.dek: Many-body localization transition in transmon networks remains robust against correlated disorder and non-local interactions.
items.unproven: practical implications for real transmon device tuning, whether engineered disorder patterns are achievable in production hardware

items.title: From triangles to prisms: towards a geometric extension of concurrence fill for three-qubit mixed states
items.dek: Concurrence fill metric extends from pure to mixed three-qubit states via geometric visualization with concurrence prisms.
items.unproven: computational tractability for larger systems, whether this measure provides actionable advantages over existing multipartite entanglement quantifiers

items.title: A unifying framework for quantum algorithms for time-dependent non-unitary dynamics
items.dek: Autonomization framework applies existing quantum ODE solvers to time-dependent non-unitary dynamics by lifting to autonomous system.
items.unproven: resource scaling compared to direct time-dependent approaches, empirical validation on realistic problem sizes

items.title: Niobium Titanium Nitride as a High Tensile Stress Material for Nanomechanics
items.dek: Niobium titanium nitride nanostring resonators achieve 0.81 GPa tensile stress and quality factor 850, promising for integrated superconducting circuits.
items.unproven: coherence performance in actual superconducting qubit integration, scaling to coupled resonator arrays

items.title: Beyond Text Matching: Towards Reference-Free Evaluation for Human-Oriented Binary Reverse Engineering
items.dek: LLM-as-Judge achieves 63% correlation with human judgment on function-name recovery, binary summarization, and decompilation tasks.
items.unproven: does not establish whether correlations hold on out-of-distribution binaries or transfer to real reverse-engineering workflows

items.title: Multimode phonon-mediated enhancement of entanglement and competing synchronization in cavity magnomechanics
items.dek: Multimode phonon-mediated coupling in cavity magnomechanics enhances entanglement monotonically with phonon number.
items.unproven: experimental demonstration, scalability to high phonon occupation, competing effects with damping in realistic systems

items.title: An Analysis of Architectural and Operational Dynamics of Phishkits in the Wild
items.dek: Analysis of 1,300 phishkits from 2020–2023 finds 22% lack evasion, most rely on messaging services for data exfiltration.
items.unproven: does not establish how findings apply to phishkit prevalence or attacker behavior outside the collected corpus

items.title: An Exploratory Evaluation of LLM-Assisted Rewriting of Moderate-Complexity Financial Sentences for DisCoCat-Based Sentiment Analysis
items.dek: LLM-assisted sentence rewriting improves quantum NLP circuit efficiency on financial sentiment; niche application with marginal gains.
items.unproven: whether modest accuracy improvements (0.550 vs 0.521) hold on production financial data or generalize beyond sentiment classification

items.title: QMIMO: Circuit Based Quantum MIMO Design with Variational Receiver
items.dek: Quantum circuit receiver for MIMO channels underperforms classical detectors; experimental quantum communications without security implication.
items.unproven: whether trade-offs hold at scale or justify quantum approach for any practical communication task

items.title: Origin of Long-Lived Nuclear Spin States and Coherences in Aliphatic Chains Revealed by Relaxation Theory
items.dek: Long-lived nuclear spin states in aliphatic chains arise from zero-eigenvalue subspaces of the relaxation superoperator.
items.unproven: NMR physics is outside the reader's remit; no connection to application security, SDLC tooling, or secure code practices.

noise.title: Amazon Is Creating the Biggest Pollution Source in the Country
noise.dek: Environmental policy piece on Amazon's data center footprint; outside application security.

noise.title: Open-source interactive map for the Aug 12 total solar eclipse
noise.dek: Interactive eclipse map for August 12 total solar eclipse.
